maya: quick heads-up: int8 canary (horizon-liteq-v3) returning higher structured func-call parse errors this morning (~4.8% vs 0.2% fp32).

deploy-bot: Canary deploy horizon-liteq-v3 (10%) started by @maya at 2026-03-21T05:00:00Z

maya: sample bad output:
```
{"action":"open_ticket","args":{"user":42,}}
```

alex: trailing comma + newline before EOF. looks like suffix-token noise, maybe kv-cache boundary.

sam: can we run paired parity (fp32 vs int8) over failing seeds and diff token streams?

maya: kicked off parity job parity/546999/1k. early results: int8 failures 4.7%, fp32 0.3%. token diffs show an extra ","+"
" before final brace in many cases.

katie: propose quick guardrail: enable soft-json-repair + retry=1 for canary only, and lower batch_window_ms to 10ms. will inform support.

devex: rolling canary-sanitizer patch (soft repair + retry + batching) and enabling postprocess snapshots to S3 for failed parses.

maya: action items: sam run kv-cache-off replicate, alex run 300-prompt schema-eval, katie draft support note. abort if downstream error >0.25%.

alex: i'll post token-alignment charts after eval.

maya: TL;DR: int8 suffix noise -> soft repair + one retry as stopgap; follow-ups = kv-cache toggle, tokenizer probe, schema harness.
